title.value: Challenge of heat adaptation in cities and public action: Contributions of interdisciplinarity and action research - Case of the Toulouse Metropolis
title.justification: The title reflects the core focus of the paper, which is on heat adaptation in urban areas and the role of interdisciplinarity and action research in public action, specifically in the context of the Toulouse Metropolis.
title.quote: Challenge of heat adaptation in cities and public action - Contributions of interdisciplinarity and action research - Case of the Toulouse Metropolis.

analysis.description: This paper discusses the importance of adapting to heat in urban environments through the lens of public policy and interdisciplinary research, specifically examining the case of the Toulouse Metropolis. It outlines how various research projects have contributed to understanding and addressing climate and energy issues in this region by bringing together different fields of study and involving urban stakeholders.

type.justification: The paper discusses interdisciplinary approaches to addressing climate adaptation in urban settings and involves theoretical models and collaborative frameworks rather than empirical data collection or experiments.
type.quote: The present article proposes to return to the synergy made possible by this collaboration, by showing on the one hand the interdisciplinary work process put in place and on the other hand data and expertise which have been produced.

name.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on adapting to climate changes in urban settings, with a significant emphasis on urban climate dynamics and the corresponding public policies.
name.quote: Keywords: climate adaptation, urban climate, interdisciplinarity, collaboration between researchers and urban actors, Toulouse Metropolis.

name.justification: A significant portion of the paper is dedicated to the role of interdisciplinarity in addressing climate adaptation issues in urban environments.
name.quote: The present article proposes to return to the synergy made possible by this collaboration, in showing... the interdisciplinary work process put in place.

name.justification: The paper heavily discusses action research methodologies as a tool for implementing climate adaptation strategies within urban planning.
name.quote: Contributions of interdisciplinarity and action research - Case of the Toulouse Metropolis.
